audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Fiora levels 1 through 4-5 plus first item and two items, while the win rate is 51.32% over 76 games, the packet chart reads Fiora / Skill / Maokai x5, and the published Fiora-side audit sets exactly that. The page also called itself 'FAV' while its difficulty text, tone colour and final rating all said 8.5/10 hard.
audit.why: Chart, rating and framing disagreed with each other, with the data and with the mirror at the same time.
audit.corrected: Row 1 to Skill, rows 2-6 to Maokai in both layers with ratings raised; diffRating 8.5/10 to 6/10, tone to the even-lane amber, and breakdown.difficulty, report[14].t and report[2].t rewritten to match a favoured lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riposte was described as parrying 'your Q'. The interaction that matters is Twisted Advance: the dash itself is untargetable, but the root on arrival is an immobilizing effect, which is precisely what turns her stab into a stun.
audit.why: A player who thinks only his Q is at risk will W in on cooldown and hand her a free stun on his main engage.
audit.corrected: report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, early and wants.foe[0] now name the arrival root as the parry target and state the untargetable flight.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and the packet flags that the page names almost none of Fiora's abilities.
audit.why: Riposte is 24s at rank 1 and Lunge is 13s at rank 1 — both are long, and both are the windows a Maokai commits inside. Naming Lunge, Duelist's Dance and Grand Challenge also makes the vital advice concrete.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, early, mid and spikes[1]; Lunge and Duelist's Dance now named in whys[0], spikes[1], early and mid.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries your Q + stuns. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.after: 24s at rank 1. It parries your arrival root and stuns you — bait it.

edits.before: Track Fiora's Riposte: Parries your Q + stuns. Bait it. When it is down — W-Q + R her.
edits.after: The dash is untargetable, but the arrival root is what Riposte parries into a stun.

edits.before: Fiora owns Level 1 — you have only one ability and no combo, so her Q-dash and a free vital punish you before you can root anything.
edits.after: Fiora owns Level 1 — you have one ability and no combo, so Lunge and a free Duelist's Dance vital punish you before you can root anything.

edits.before: R (Nature's Grasp) makes your gank setup and lockdown lethal — she can Q-dash away from most ganks, so wall off her escape with brambles when your jungler arrives.
edits.after: R (Nature's Grasp) makes your gank setup lethal — Lunge is her only escape and it is 13s at rank 1, so wall it off the moment your jungler arrives.

edits.before: Level 1 is hers — you have a single ability and no combo, so she can walk up and proc a vital with her Q-dash before you can answer. Don't trade into her at one point; just last-hit and wait for your spike. Once you hit Levels 2-3 the lane flips: W (Twisted Advance) roots her in place, Q (Bramble Smash) knocks her back, and Sap Magic heals the trade right back — she can't kite a point-and-click root. The key discipline is her W parry — don't throw your W or commit a cast when she's holding it up, or she negates your lockdown and stuns you. Bait the parry with an E (Sapling Toss) or a fake step-up first.
edits.after: Level 1 is hers — you have a single ability and no combo, so she walks up and procs a vital with Lunge before you can answer. Don't trade into her at one point; last-hit and wait for your spike. Once you hit Levels 2-3 the lane flips: W (Twisted Advance) roots her in place, Q (Bramble Smash) knocks her back, and Sap Magic heals the trade right back — she can't kite a point-and-click root. The discipline is Riposte: 24s at rank 1, and it parries your arrival root into a stun, so never commit W while she holds it. Bait it with a sapling or a fake step-up first.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are your strongest stretch. Your root and Q cooldowns are low enough to repeat favorable trades, and every time you proc Sap Magic you erase the vital chip she lands. Keep E (Sapling Toss) on the wave and in the brush she wants to dash into so she can't farm a free vital. At 6, R (Nature's Grasp) doesn't win the raw 1v1 outright, but it makes your ganks brutal — she has only her Q-dash to escape, so wall it off when your jungler shows. Always respect the parry timing: commit W when her W is on cooldown, not when she's baiting you onto it.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are your strongest stretch. Your root and Q cooldowns are low enough to repeat favorable trades, and every Sap Magic proc erases the vital chip she lands. Keep E (Sapling Toss) on the wave and in the brush she wants to dash into so she can't farm a free vital. At 6, R (Nature's Grasp) doesn't win the raw 1v1 outright, but it makes your ganks brutal — Lunge is her only escape, so wall it off when your jungler shows. Commit W inside Riposte's 24s, never into a parry she is baiting.

edits.before: Bait your W (Twisted Advance) or root commitment, then W-parry the key cast to negate the trade and stun you
edits.after: Bait your W (Twisted Advance) commitment, then Riposte the arrival root to negate it and stun you
